title: E-RLT-0116: the bound register pair's lines at K 0.32, open (gates fixed before the run): filter diagonalization...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0116 in the relativity arena: the bound register pair's lines at K 0.32, open (gates fixed before the run): filter diagonalization resolves twelve synthetic line branches exactly (axis 0 and 3.75e-3, body 0, 1.25e-3 and 5.0e-3), but the pair's K = 0 line (weight 0.82) has neighbors 3.1e-3 and 4.1e-3 away and mixes with them at this momentum, so the whole-line gate reads neither one band nor branches on the body diagonal (heaviest line 0.57, shift 1.72e-3 against 1.85e-3) and branches on the axis (0.27); no line stays near the K = 0 energy, where line branches with n . u = 0 would.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
